items.t: Joined a complaint filed in Cook County Circuit Court together with the Illinois GOP and other plaintiffs.
items.q: The Illinois GOP joined Cook County State’s Attorney candidate Bob Fioretti, Cook County Clerk candidate Michelle Pennington, Fourth District U.S. congressional candidate Lupe Castillo and registered voter Jaime Martello in a complaint filed Friday in Cook County Circuit Court.
